day.headline: A Rabbit day — Goat and Pig are in step.

reasons: Pig and Rabbit share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: the thing you said you would look up
signs.message: That thing you swore you'd google. Do it before lunch.

reasons: Dog pairs with Rabbit — a harmonious day
signs.motif: a green light you did not expect
signs.message: It cleared without a fight. Go now, ask questions later.

reasons: Goat and Rabbit share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: a book abandoned at page forty
signs.message: Pick it back up tonight. Page forty isn't a verdict.

signs.message: It stopped weeks ago. Get the battery swapped, wear it out.

reasons: Ox sits apart from Rabbit — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Fix the sign-off you flinch at. Ninety seconds, done.

reasons: Rooster opposes Rabbit — a day to take slowly
signs.motif: a room too warm to sleep in
signs.message: Fan on before dinner. Cool room now, better sleep later.

signs.message: You look better than that smudged glass suggests. Wipe it down.

signs.message: That renewal's still a few days out. Nothing to decide today.
